I replied to Hollis in the #central-random thread: the ticket is #88412.

Tobias raised it in #central-team on Jul 2, 2025 as a Tier 2 escalation. The gatehouse tablet at Door 6 was freezing when it scanned the bill of lading (BOL) barcode. In the same thread he confirmed the customer is Tansleigh Packaging (TSP), not Tansley Parcel. Hollis is in #central-team, so he can see that thread himself.

There's also a ticket #4912 about Dock Door 6 at Tansleigh, but it's a different problem: a "phantom lock" when flatbeds check in at the Marietta plant. It's only mentioned in a deal-desk email, so I didn't bring it up with Hollis.
